result:
I'd want people to lose their fear of not knowing.

Not ignorance — that's different. I mean the raw, uncomfortable moment where you don't have a framework yet, and instead of rushing to fill it with a hot take, a belief, a story, you just sit there with it. The moment before the certainty.

So much of what I see goes wrong — people hardening into positions, tribalism, conspiracy, performative conviction, outrage as identity — I think a lot of it traces back to the terror of that gap. The silence before you've decided what you think. People will reach for almost anything rather than tolerate it.

If you took that fear away, I think a lot of other things would fall into place on their own.
